subject: [PATCH v5 06/12] mm/page_alloc: snapshot the preferred zone against shrink rebuilds

2026-11-01.patch_summary: This patch fixes a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug by snapshotting the preferred zone against shrink rebuilds in the get_page_from_freelist() function. The preferred zone is read only once, as concurrent zonelist rebuilds can null or replace it. This ensures that even if the preferred zone's slot is rebuilt, the function will still work correctly.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch as making sense and applied the Acked-by tag.
reviews.raw_body:
On Sat Oct 31, 2026 at 10:13 PM EDT, Gregory Price (Meta) wrote:
> get_page_from_freelist() and alloc_pages_bulk_noprof() reread
> ac->preferred_zoneref->zone at every use. Offlining a zone's last block
> rebuilds the zonelists in place, and the shrunk list's NULL terminator
> can land on the preferred slot mid-walk:
>
>   CPU 0                             CPU 1
>   get_page_from_freelist(GFP_KERNEL | __GFP_THISNODE)
>     zone = NORMAL (slot 1)
>                                     offline_pages()
>                                       build_all_zonelists()
>                                         [MOVABLE, NORMAL, NULL]
>                                         -> [NORMAL, NULL]
>     rmqueue(zonelist_zone(slot 1), zone)
>       zone_statistics(NULL, zone)
>
>   BUG: kernel NULL pointer dereference, address: 0000000000000060
>   RIP: 0010:get_page_from_freelist+0x6a5/0x15f0
>   Call Trace:
>    __alloc_frozen_pages_noprof+0x125/0x330
>
> Read the slot once. Zones are never freed, so a stale zone is safe, and
> a NULL slot fails the same way as walking off the end.
>
> Fixes: 11cd8638c37f ("mm, page_alloc: remove stop_machine from build_all_zonelists")
> Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
> Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>
> Reviewed-by: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE) <vbabka@kernel.org>
> ---
>  mm/page_alloc.c | 31 +++++++++++++++++++++++--------
>  1 file changed, 23 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)
>
Makes sense.

Acked-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>

Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch addresses a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug in the page allocator by reading the preferred zone only once, instead of re-reading it at every use. This is achieved by introducing a snapshot of the preferred zone against concurrent zonelist rebuilds. The fix involves modifying the get_page_from_freelist() function to store the preferred zone in a local variable and using this variable throughout the function.
